hypothesis: Resolve real native font families and exact TTC face indices for both measurement and rendering. Keep absent explicitly requested fonts as errors; optional unused Windows families must not block a ready Mac. Bind/extract genuine single faces for dynamic typography; supply selected fonts directly to libass. Font environment, language and mapping changes invalidate visual cache. On this CoreText build Arabic Geeza initially fell back through Helvetica even though cmap passed; Arial with the verified Arabic cmap and a supplied face rendered the sample without glyph fallback. Never infer renderer selection from API success or cmap alone.
limitations: Mac host and synthetic samples only; no live Windows/Linux validation.
Eight script groups and selected faces do not prove every future glyph or layout fits.
Same-agent technical/visual review; no independent language or advertising acceptance.
evidence_boundary: Self-contained observed technical facts and source hashes. Temporary render paths are not required to understand the hypothesis; re-run native-font tests on the target host. No rule promotion.
